verdict.rationale: ZCode is a vibe-coding tool, and its docs say it bundles GLM-5.3-Flash with out-of-the-box screenshot understanding and image analysis. That suggests image inputs can feed its code-generation workflow, but no evidence shows it turning a design into a working app. missing for 10: documented image/screenshot-to-app generation, sketch input support, PDF design input support, hands-on or independent corroboration of producing working apps from designs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design

citations.quote: GLM-5.3-Flash 同步接入，截图理解、看图分析等多模态任务开箱即用。
ZCode 是新一代氛围编程工具，多智能体协作完成复杂目标
